purpose: Declare the P1.6 live connector boundaries without containing credentials.

salesforce.authentication: OAuth 2.0 External Client App with PKCE and refresh token
salesforce.api: Salesforce REST API latest alias; tested mocks model v68.0
salesforce.initial_sync: QueryAll pagination followed by complete sObject reads for active records
salesforce.incremental_sync: sObject Get Updated and Get Deleted polling with overlap

hubspot.authentication: Scoped Service Key or existing private-app bearer token
hubspot.initial_sync: Active and archived CRM object pagination
hubspot.incremental_sync: CRM Search updated-time polling plus archived-object polling

storage.implementation: existing P1.2 and P1.3 SQLite stores
storage.future_boundary: replace local files with managed secret and object storage without changing source events
